findings.system: human ovarian carcinoma cell line (paclitaxel-resistant SKOV3-TR30 vs parental SKOV3)
findings.finding: Acquired paclitaxel resistance co-occurs with a weakened SAC and low BubR1 (association in a derived resistant line; BubR1 was not manipulated).
findings.sentence: This study demonstrates that weakened spindle checkpoint with reduced expression of BubR1, but not Mad2, is associated with acquired paclitaxel resistance in ovarian carcinoma cells.
findings.caveats: Association in one derived cancer line; no BUB1B mutation; says nothing about toxicity in normal tissue. For the child: if a tumour arises with low BUBR1, taxane efficacy could be lower (hypothesis).

findings.system: human cells and tumour material carrying germline BUB1B variants (prostate cancer predisposition study)
findings.finding: BUB1B variants that lower BubR1 expression/stability cause premature chromatid separation, CIN and resistance to Taxol-based therapy.
findings.sentence: BUB1B variants lead to decreased BubR1 expression and/or stability, which promotes increased premature chromatid separation and, consequently, triggers CIN, driving resistance to Taxol-based therapies.
findings.caveats: Monoallelic variants from prostate-cancer families, not biallelic MVA; the abstract does not detail which experiment tested taxane response (gene-editing and ex vivo material are listed).

findings.system: human pancreatic cancer cell line PANC-1 (CRISPRi/KO screen)
findings.finding: Knockdown of BUB1B (also BUB3, TTK) attenuates paclitaxel-induced death: a weak SAC lowers sensitivity to nab-paclitaxel.
findings.sentence: Knockdown of these SAC genes (BUB1B, BUB3, and TTK) attenuates paclitaxel-induced cell death.
findings.caveats: One cancer line; knockdown, not a patient mutation; tumour efficacy only. Same direction as 17234259 (less sensitive).

findings.system: human tumours and cell lines with chromosomal instability (OV01 ovarian trial, cell lines)
findings.finding: High CIN associated with taxane resistance but carboplatin sensitivity.
findings.sentence: In the OV01 ovarian cancer clinical trial, a high level of CIN was associated with taxane resistance but carboplatin sensitivity, indicating that CIN may determine MTS response in vivo.
findings.caveats: CIN measured in ovarian tumours is not constitutional BUBR1 deficiency; one trial; MTS = microtubule-stabilising agents.

findings.system: human tumours with chromosomal instability (OV01 ovarian trial)
findings.finding: High CIN associated with taxane resistance but carboplatin sensitivity (tumour-level association).
findings.sentence: In the OV01 ovarian cancer clinical trial, a high level of CIN was associated with taxane resistance but carboplatin sensitivity, indicating that CIN may determine MTS response in vivo.
findings.caveats: Association in ovarian cancer only. In a child with a genome-instability syndrome, platinum genotoxicity is itself a safety concern (39264246, 33209710), so this is NOT a candidate for the patient.

findings.system: human breast cancer tumours and cell culture
findings.finding: Against the SAC-arrest model of taxane action: at drug levels reached in tumours, paclitaxel kills through multipolar-spindle missegregation and mitotic arrest is dispensable for regression, so a weak SAC may not by itself predict taxane failure.
findings.sentence: Contrary to the previous hypothesis, we find that mitotic arrest is dispensable for tumor regression in patients.
findings.caveats: The abstract does not mention BubR1 or a weak SAC; it is counter-evidence to the resistance logic above, not a direct test.

findings.system: human cancer cell line (DESI1 knockdown lowers SAC activity)
findings.finding: Reduced SAC activity (DESI1 knockdown) lowers vincristine sensitivity through mitotic slippage.
findings.sentence: Importantly, we found that DESI1 knockdown reduced sensitivity to vincristine by inducing mitotic slippage.
findings.caveats: The SAC defect is DESI1 knockdown (FoxM1/Aurora B), not BUBR1; supports only the mitotic-slippage direction for vinca alkaloids in cells with a weak SAC.

findings.system: human acute myeloid leukaemia cells
findings.finding: Repressed BubR1 in AML is linked to a limited response to spindle poisons (taxane/vinca class); restoring cyclin B enhances the response.
findings.sentence: We demonstrated a link between the repression of the spindle assembly checkpoint protein BubR1 in acute myeloid leukemia and the limited response to spindle poison.
findings.caveats: No single drug named in the abstract; AML is not the child's tumour but is relevant to the leukaemia risk in MVA.

findings.system: non-transformed human RPE1 clones with chemically induced aneuploidy (and cancer lines)
findings.finding: Highly aneuploid clones are more sensitive to the MEK inhibitor trametinib (mainly an anti-proliferative effect).
findings.sentence: The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more sensitive to the clinically-approved MEK inhibitor, trametinib (Fig. 5e ), and tended to be more sensitive to selumetinib as well (Supplementary Fig. 9e ).
findings.caveats: Aneuploidy was induced (reversine) in RPE1, not BUB1B-deficient. The same paper says CRAF inhibition is "mostly cytostatic, rather than cytotoxic". An anti-proliferative effect on aneuploid cells would also reach the patient's normal mosaic aneuploid tissue. Hypothesis only.

findings.system: non-transformed human RPE1 clones with chemically induced aneuploidy
findings.finding: Aneuploid clones only "tended to be more sensitive" to selumetinib (supplementary figure).
findings.sentence: The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more sensitive to the clinically-approved MEK inhibitor, trametinib (Fig. 5e ), and tended to be more sensitive to selumetinib as well (Supplementary Fig. 9e ).
findings.caveats: Tendency only; same caveats as trametinib.

findings.system: human aneuploid RPE1 clones and patient data
findings.finding: Resistance of patients to olaparib is associated with high RAF/MEK/ERK signalling in highly aneuploid tumours.
findings.sentence: Moreover, resistance of cancer patients to olaparib is associated with high levels of RAF/MEK/ERK signaling, specifically in highly-aneuploid tumors.
findings.caveats: No paper was found showing PARP-inhibitor synthetic lethality with BUBR1 loss or a weak SAC. Aneuploidy here was induced, not SAC-defective.

findings.system: human RPE1 aneuploid clones (olaparib, etoposide, topotecan tested)
findings.finding: Highly aneuploid clones were significantly more RESISTANT to olaparib, etoposide and topotecan than pseudo-diploid clones.
findings.sentence: To validate these results, we treated aneuploid clones with two clinically relevant chemotherapies—the DSB-inducing etoposide and the SSB-inducing topotecan—and with the PARP inhibitor olaparib. The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more resistant to these drugs compared to pseudo-diploid clones
findings.caveats: Evidence AGAINST an aneuploidy-selective PARP-inhibitor or topoisomerase-poison vulnerability, in an induced-aneuploidy cell model.

findings.system: human RPE1 aneuploid clones and reversine-aneuploidized lines
findings.finding: Highly aneuploid clones significantly more resistant to etoposide (opposite of genotoxin hypersensitivity).
findings.sentence: To validate these results, we treated aneuploid clones with two clinically relevant chemotherapies—the DSB-inducing etoposide and the SSB-inducing topotecan—and with the PARP inhibitor olaparib. The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more resistant to these drugs compared to pseudo-diploid clones
findings.caveats: Induced aneuploidy in culture; does not address constitutional SAC deficiency, whole-body toxicity or second cancers.

findings.system: adult ovarian cancer patients (real-world TriNetX cohort)
findings.finding: PARP-inhibitor maintenance associated with a higher incidence of MDS/AML.
findings.sentence: Our study indicates that PARPi may increase the risk of MDS or AML after first-line maintenance treatment.
findings.caveats: Adults with ovarian cancer; class-level statement ("no significant differences ... between the various PARPi"); not MVA. For a child with MDS/leukaemia predisposition it is an indirect (L0) warning.

findings.system: meta-analysis of randomised trials of PARP inhibitors in solid tumours
findings.finding: Contradicting report: PARP inhibitors did not increase AML/MDS risk in a meta-analysis (though haematological toxicity increased).
findings.sentence: PARPis did not increase the risk of AML/MDS (p = 0.86).
findings.caveats: Conflicts with 40794554; adult trials with short follow-up.

findings.system: mouse embryonic fibroblasts trisomic for chromosomes 1/13/16/19 and human aneuploid cancer lines
findings.finding: The autophagy inhibitor chloroquine reported to cause lethality in aneuploid but not euploid cells.
findings.sentence: Compounds that cause lethality in aneuploid, but not euploid, cells could therefore provide new cancer therapies. We have identified the energy stress-inducing agent AICAR, the protein folding inhibitor 17-AAG, and the autophagy inhibitor chloroquine as exhibiting this property.
findings.caveats: Selectivity for aneuploid cells would also act on the patient's normal mosaic aneuploid cells: double-edged. Trisomic MEF model, not SAC-defective.

findings.system: patient with PCS/MVA with biallelic BUB1B mutations and bilateral Wilms tumour (case report)
findings.finding: Severe adverse reaction to dactinomycin monotherapy prevented further chemotherapy.
findings.sentence: After right nephrectomy, dactinomycin monotherapy was administered for the left Wilms tumor; however, severe adverse reaction prevented the patient from receiving further chemotherapy.
findings.caveats: Single case; the abstract does not describe the reaction; unknown whether it generalises to other drugs.

findings.system: 11-year-old boy with MVA1 (BUB1B), MDS with monosomy 7, HSCT (case report)
findings.finding: After treosulfan-based reduced-intensity conditioning and HSCT: engraftment, then graft rejection, pancytopenia, sepsis and death.
findings.sentence: The engraftment occurred, and no severe toxicity was observed soon after the HSCT, but on day + 47, graft rejection was detected.
findings.caveats: Single case; cause of rejection unclear; the conditioning regimen is only one component (the abstract states "using a treosulfan-based reduced intensity conditioning (RIC) regimen").

findings.system: children with genomic instability disorders including MVA (AACR workshop review)
findings.finding: Genomic-instability disorders (as a group) can show exquisite sensitivity to ionizing radiation and chemotherapy, which may raise second-cancer risk; MVA is one of the disorders discussed.
findings.sentence: Many of these genomic instability disorders also present with exquisite sensitivity to anticancer treatments such as ionizing radiation and chemotherapy, which may further increase the risk of second cancers.
findings.caveats: The sentence concerns the group (ATM, NBS, FA, XP, BLM, RTS, telomere disorders, MVA); the abstract does not say MVA itself is radiosensitive; no MVA-specific radiation experiment was found.

findings.system: review of syndromic Wilms tumour (text on MVA)
findings.finding: Genetic anomalies in MVA may complicate chemotherapy, increasing risk of intolerable side effects or secondary malignancy.
findings.sentence: The genetic anomalies seen in patients with mosaic variegated aneuploidy may complicate chemotherapeutic regimens, increasing their risk of intolerable side effects or secondary malignancy.
findings.caveats: Review statement based on the case literature (e.g. 31081598), not systematic data.

findings.system: human breast cancer cell line MDA-MB-231 with BUB1B shRNA knockdown and xenografts
findings.finding: BUB1B promotes homologous-recombination repair and influences radioresistance; knockdown implies lower repair capacity.
findings.sentence: Furthermore, BUB1B had a significant influence on the radioresistance of breast cancer, and promoted homologous recombination‑mediated DNA damage repair and cell cycle arrest.
findings.caveats: Radiation, not a drug. Cancer line with high BUB1B; the direction (less BUB1B = more radiosensitive) is inferred from "promoted ... repair" and the knockdown design; not an MVA or patient cell.

findings.system: human bladder cancer cells (chemoradiation-recurrent clones)
findings.finding: Higher BUB1B/BUBR1 gives enhanced DSB repair and resistance to DNA-damaging agents (low BUBR1 not tested).
findings.sentence: CRT-recurrent BC cells exhibited a cell-cycle-independent upregulation of BUB1B/BUBR1 expression rendering an enhanced DNA repair activity in response to DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs).
findings.caveats: Overexpression model; inference for BUBR1 deficiency is only indirect.

findings.system: PCS-MVA patient with rhabdomyosarcoma (case report)
findings.finding: Title only reports reduced-intensity chemotherapy; no abstract or full text in Europe PMC, so no sentence can be verified.
findings.caveats: Europe PMC record has no abstract (title only). NOT used as support.

background_evidence.system: child with PCS/MVA and biallelic BUB1B
background_evidence.finding: Bilateral Wilms tumour in biallelic BUB1B PCS/MVA.
background_evidence.sentence: We report a 38-month-old Japanese male with premature chromatid separation/mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome bearing biallelic BUB1B germline mutations who suffered from bilateral Wilms tumor.
background_evidence.caveats: Case report. The abstract also reports long remission after bilateral nephrectomy plus dialysis (not used as advice).

background_evidence.system: embryonal RMS from an MVA case with biallelic BUB1B mutations
background_evidence.finding: CGH of the RMS: gains of chromosomes 3, 8, 13 and losses of 9, 14, X, typical of sporadic embryonal RMS.
background_evidence.sentence: To further investigate the role of BUB1B in cancer predisposition we performed comparative genomic hybridization analysis in an embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma from an MVA case with biallelic BUB1B mutations, revealing aneuploidies typical of sporadic E-RMS, with gain of chromosomes 3, 8, 13 and loss of chromosomes 9, 14, X.

background_evidence.finding: MVA1 carries a high risk of rhabdomyosarcoma, Wilms tumour, myelodysplasia and leukaemia; malignancy incidence 38.7% in the reviewed cases.
background_evidence.sentence: Malignancies had noticeably a high incidence (38.7%) with Wilms tumor, rhabdomyosarcoma and leukemia being the most frequently reported
background_evidence.caveats: Literature review of 31 cases; ascertainment bias likely.

background_evidence.finding: RMS in MVA tends to arise in the genitourinary tract (vagina, bladder), embryonal/botryoid.
background_evidence.sentence: While data is limited, RMS in mosaic variegated aneuploidy is highly likely to occur in the GU tract, primarily in the vagina and bladder, and is more likely to be embryonal and exhibit botryoid features.
background_evidence.caveats: Review; the authors say data are limited.

background_evidence.finding: Published surveillance recommendations for MVA are scarce; low threshold to investigate new tumour-related symptoms.
background_evidence.sentence: While surveillance recommendations for rare cancer predisposition syndromes like mosaic variegated aneuploidy are not widely published, when cancer risks are elevated but specifics are unknown, increased awareness and low threshold for investigating new potential tumor-related symptoms is essential
background_evidence.caveats: Statement of the review, not a recommendation from this project.

background_evidence.system: case report with long follow-up, BUB1B MVA
background_evidence.finding: Literature statement on MVA surveillance: regular abdominal ultrasound for Wilms; no evidence that routine screening for other rare tumours is beneficial.
background_evidence.sentence: It is recommended that patients with MVA syndrome have regular abdominal ultrasound surveillance, to particularly look for Wilms tumor. However, as the incidence rate of other rare tumor in MVA is unknown, there is still no evidence to indicate that routine screening is beneficial.
background_evidence.caveats: Statement inside a case report. The AACR 2024 update (39264246) is the formal source, but only its abstract was accessible.

background_evidence.system: case report, MVA1 with myelodysplastic syndrome
background_evidence.finding: MDS with monosomy 7 at age 9 in MVA1.
background_evidence.sentence: The patient presented with cytopenia soon after birth, but remained stable until 9 years of age, when he developed myelodysplastic syndrome associated with monosomy of chromosome 7.

background_evidence.system: RMS cell lines and xenografts (shRNA screen)
background_evidence.finding: Bub1b is essential for growth/survival of rhabdomyosarcoma cells; knockdown causes mitotic catastrophe and tumour regression.
background_evidence.sentence: We identified Bub1b as an essential element for the growth and survival of rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) cells using a bar-coded, tetracycline-inducible short hairpin RNA (shRNA) library screen.
background_evidence.caveats: Sporadic RMS lines: cancer cells depend on BUB1B. Gives no drug candidate for the child.

background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid cancer cells are increasingly sensitive to SAC inhibition over time (time-dependent).
background_evidence.sentence: Indeed, aneuploid cancer cells became increasingly sensitive to inhibition of SAC over time.

background_evidence.finding: Wilms tumour in 7/8 patients with BUB1B mutations in a 35-patient review.
background_evidence.sentence: Patients with monoallelic BUB1B mutations were severely affected with Dandy-Walker complex (7/8), cataracts (6/6), and Wilms' tumor (7/8)
background_evidence.caveats: "Monoallelic" means one mutation was detected; not the same as this child's genotype; small series.

background_evidence.system: AACR workshop review on genomic-instability disorders including MVA
background_evidence.finding: An AACR 2024 update on screening and surveillance covers MVA (full text not accessible, so its content is not verified).
background_evidence.sentence: This article discusses childhood cancer risks and surveillance recommendations for the group of genomic instability disorders with predominantly recessive inheritance, including the DNA repair disorders ataxia telangiectasia, Nijmegen breakage syndrome, Fanconi anemia, xeroderma pigmentosum, Bloom syndrome, and Rothmund-Thomson syndrome, as well as the telomere biology disorders and mosaic variegated aneuploidy.
background_evidence.caveats: Only the abstract could be downloaded (full-text XML returned HTTP 500).

not_approved.finding: NMN raises BubR1 abundance in vivo; SIRT2 overexpression extends median lifespan of BubR1 H/H mice.
not_approved.sentence: Overexpression of SIRT2 or treatment of mice with the NAD(+) precursor nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) increases BubR1 abundance in vivo. Overexpression of SIRT2 in BubR1(H/H) animals increases median lifespan, with a greater effect in male mice.
not_approved.caveats: NMN is not in the approved universe. The lifespan rescue was with a SIRT2 transgene, not NMN. Raising BubR1 presumes a functional residual allele (null allele plus a VUS of unknown effect).

not_approved.system: breast cancer cells with increasing aneuploidy (PREPRINT, not peer reviewed)
not_approved.finding: Increasing aneuploidy sensitizes cells to WEE1 inhibition (chromosome pulverisation).
not_approved.sentence: We show that increasing aneuploidy in breast cancer cells sensitizes to the inhibition of WEE1 kinase.
not_approved.caveats: PREPRINT. WEE1 inhibitors (adavosertib) are not approved and not in the universe.

not_approved.finding: Aneuploid cells are vulnerable to KIF18A depletion; aneuploid cells less sensitive than diploid to short-term SAC inhibition but increasingly sensitive over time.
not_approved.sentence: Aneuploid cancer cells were particularly vulnerable to depletion of KIF18A, and KIF18A overexpression restored their response to SAC inhibition.
not_approved.caveats: KIF18A and MPS1 inhibitors are not approved.

not_approved.finding: CENP-E inhibition causes aneuploidy with proteotoxic stress and p53-mediated apoptosis in SAC-attenuated cells; antitumour activity in an SAC-impaired xenograft.
not_approved.sentence: Because Compound-A causes p53 accumulation and antitumour activity in an SAC-impaired xenograft model, CENP-E inhibitors could be potential anticancer drugs effective against SAC-impaired tumours.

not_approved.finding: AICAR induces p53-mediated apoptosis in trisomic MEFs.
not_approved.sentence: AICAR induces p53-mediated apoptosis in primary mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) trisomic for chromosome 1, 13, 16, or 19.
not_approved.caveats: AICAR/acadesine and 17-AAG (tanespimycin) are not in the approved universe.

no_evidence: No primary paper found testing PARP inhibitors (olaparib, niraparib, talazoparib, rucaparib) in cells with BUB1B/BUBR1 loss, MVA patient cells or BubR1-hypomorphic mice. Only induced-aneuploidy RPE1 clones, which were MORE resistant to olaparib (39251587).
No primary paper found on ATR inhibitors in cells with BUBR1 loss or a weak SAC; no ATR inhibitor is approved in the universe (ceralasertib not present).
WEE1: only a bioRxiv preprint (aneuploid breast cancer cells, 10.1101/2023.09.19.558475); adavosertib is not approved/not in the universe; nothing in BUBR1-deficient or MVA cells.

No experiment found of any approved drug rescuing or lowering aneuploidy/CIN in BUBR1-deficient human cells or BubR1 hypomorphic mice. The only BubR1-raising intervention found was NMN (not approved) or SIRT2 transgene (24825348). No evidence for NIACIN, metformin, rapamycin/everolimus or any senolytic on BubR1 (searches 'BubR1 metformin', 'BubR1 rapamycin OR mTOR', 'BUBR1 nicotinamide riboside', 'BubR1 H/H mice senolytic' returned nothing relevant).

No MVA- or BUB1B-specific experiment on ionizing radiation or genotoxic drug sensitivity was found (searches on PCS/MVA cells with radiation/mitomycin/bleomycin returned no relevant paper). Radiation precaution rests on class-level statements (39264246, 33209710) and BUB1B knockdown in a breast cancer line (40910254).
No data on second neoplasms after radiotherapy or chemotherapy specific to MVA/BUB1B other than the generic review statements and single case reports.
31184400 (RMS with PCS-MVA, reduced-intensity chemotherapy): Europe PMC has no abstract or full text, so no sentence could be verified; used by title only and flagged verified=false.
39264246 (AACR 2024 surveillance update): full-text XML returned HTTP 500; only the abstract could be checked, so the actual MVA surveillance schedule was not verified from the primary text.
Leukaemia in MVA: only generic statements (35804254 review) and one MDS/monosomy 7 case (31053147); no surveillance schedule for leukaemia verified.

Mitotic-slippage direction with vinca alkaloids was supported only in a DESI1-knockdown model (39698932) and for AML BubR1 repression with unnamed 'spindle poison' (23812934); none in BUB1B-mutant patient cells with a named vinca drug.

Hypothesis that BUBR1-low or SAC-weak cells are MORE sensitive to taxanes (mitotic slippage vs multipolar death) was not found in the literature retrieved; all human-cell reports retrieved point to LESS sensitivity (resistance).

against_or_risk.finding: Heterozygous MVA-nonsense Bub1b allele: shorter lifespan, muscle wasting, mild aneuploidy and enhanced growth of carcinogen-induced tumours.
against_or_risk.sentence: BubR1(+/GTTA) mice develop mild aneuploidies and show enhanced growth of carcinogen-induced tumors.
against_or_risk.caveats: Mouse, carcinogen model; a warning about carcinogen exposure, not a drug finding.

against_or_risk.finding: No benefit of SIRT2 overexpression on health or lifespan in non-progeroid wild-type mice (benefit may be confined to a BubR1-low setting).
against_or_risk.sentence: Overall, we conclude that strategies to enhance SIRT2 protein levels may not lead to increased longevity.
against_or_risk.caveats: Authors' conclusion in wild-type mice; does not test BubR1-low animals.

against_or_risk.finding: Aneuploid clones activate the DNA damage response and are more resistant to further DNA damage induction (against genotoxin hypersensitivity of aneuploid cells).
against_or_risk.sentence: Aneuploid clones activate the DNA damage response and are more resistant to further DNA damage induction.
against_or_risk.caveats: Induced-aneuploidy model, not a SAC-deficient patient cell.

against_or_risk.system: review; TRIP13/BUB1B biallelic patient cells, CEP57-MVA
against_or_risk.finding: Biallelic BUB1B/TRIP13 cells severely SAC-impaired with high embryonal tumour risk; MVA from CEP57 or unknown cause lacks the tumour association.
against_or_risk.sentence: Individuals with biallelic TRIP13 or BUB1B mutations have a high risk of embryonal tumors, and here we show that their cells display severe SAC impairment.
against_or_risk.caveats: Applies to biallelic BUB1B; this child has a null allele plus a VUS with the phase unresolved.

against_or_risk.system: germline BUB1B sequencing in 192 early-onset colorectal cancer cases (negative result)
against_or_risk.finding: BUB1B germline variants unlikely to play a major role in early-onset colorectal cancer predisposition.
against_or_risk.sentence: Our data suggest that mutations in BUB1B do not occur frequently in the germline of individuals with CRC and that BUB1B unlikely plays a major role in the predisposition to early-onset CRC.
against_or_risk.caveats: Heterozygous variants; no biallelic patients; contrasts with 39014450 (prostate).

against_or_risk.system: human breast cancer tumours and cell culture
against_or_risk.finding: Against the SAC-arrest model of taxane action: at drug levels reached in tumours, paclitaxel kills through multipolar-spindle missegregation and mitotic arrest is dispensable for regression, so a weak SAC may not by itself predict taxane failure.
against_or_risk.sentence: Contrary to the previous hypothesis, we find that mitotic arrest is dispensable for tumor regression in patients.
against_or_risk.caveats: The abstract does not mention BubR1 or a weak SAC; it is counter-evidence to the resistance logic above, not a direct test.

against_or_risk.system: human RPE1 aneuploid clones (olaparib, etoposide, topotecan tested)
against_or_risk.finding: Highly aneuploid clones were significantly more RESISTANT to olaparib, etoposide and topotecan than pseudo-diploid clones.
against_or_risk.sentence: To validate these results, we treated aneuploid clones with two clinically relevant chemotherapies—the DSB-inducing etoposide and the SSB-inducing topotecan—and with the PARP inhibitor olaparib. The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more resistant to these drugs compared to pseudo-diploid clones
against_or_risk.caveats: Evidence AGAINST an aneuploidy-selective PARP-inhibitor or topoisomerase-poison vulnerability, in an induced-aneuploidy cell model.

against_or_risk.system: human RPE1 aneuploid clones and reversine-aneuploidized lines
against_or_risk.finding: Highly aneuploid clones significantly more resistant to etoposide (opposite of genotoxin hypersensitivity).
against_or_risk.sentence: To validate these results, we treated aneuploid clones with two clinically relevant chemotherapies—the DSB-inducing etoposide and the SSB-inducing topotecan—and with the PARP inhibitor olaparib. The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more resistant to these drugs compared to pseudo-diploid clones
against_or_risk.caveats: Induced aneuploidy in culture; does not address constitutional SAC deficiency, whole-body toxicity or second cancers.
